text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today was Satono Diamond's Nippon Derby. 
The result—she threw a shoe, and finished 
in 2nd place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though misfortune denied her victory, 
Satono Diamond shows no gloom. She boldly 
declares her triumph in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Kitasan Black was also pushing 
herself through grueling late-stage 
training. Satono Crown watched wide-eyed 
at her rate of growth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her rival grow at an astonishing 
rate, Satono Crown works with her Trainer 
to formulate a thorough counterstrategy.
